To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we construct arguments to be used as information to be used to persuade.
even in the absence of any desire to be truthful or to reach the truth, people turn out strongly to be little else than argumentative.
even in the absence of any explicit argumentative task, reasoning and argumentation go hand in hand.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how reasoning can serve argumentation, and argumentation can benefit reasoning.
the argumentative function of reasoning and has the scope of developing a general theory of reasoning.
the argumentative function of reasoning and its psychological manifestation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the theory of reasoning should be replaced by the theory of argumentation.
the function of reason is not to find the truth but to win arguments.
reasoning is an argumentative communication device.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the argumentative theory is a powerful and parsimonious alternative to dual process accounts in which distinct systems are set out for explaining the apparent virtues and failures of human reasoning.
reasoning is a means of increase the probability of having arguments that support our opinions.
we see reasoning as primarily social behavior, rather than a blind and mechanical processing of information.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the standard view needs to be replaced in favor of a theoretical framework that acknowledges and takes seriously the fundamental argumentative function of reasoning.
the study of reasoning needs to go back to the classics, namely the idea of reasoning as a motivational enterprise.
the study of reasoning must be pushed in a new direction, moving from the assessment and the rationality of groups and of individuals to the strategic and argumentative function of reasoning.
